source_comparison: The release tag and master differ only in .github/workflows/publish.yml and pyproject.toml; modeling source is identical.
software: PyTorch 2.13.0+cu132; CUDA runtime 13.2; wheel built for CUDA 13.0. AtomWorks 2.1.1.

timing_scope.score_gradient: Steady-state score and Cartesian gradient; GPU uses the public forward_backward CUDA graph path. Setup/capture excluded. Five warmups, seven adaptive intervals.
timing_scope.repack: Full native fixed-sequence repack; current conformer included. Rotamer generation, scoring, annealing and output assembly timed. Three seeds; setup and warmup excluded.
timing_scope.largest_warmup: The 1O7J GPU B1000 run warms a single native chunk instead of repeating an entire 1000-pose batch. Every timed call processes all 1000 poses.
timing_scope.largest_repetitions: Three seeds in separate processes on the same H200 model; full batch timed after one native-chunk warmup. Individual process records and per-sample machine metadata retained.

atom_axis: Physical atoms per structure, including hydrogen, excluding padding and PyRosetta virtual proline sites; raw stored counts retained.
native_preparation: Each native input loader and preset is retained; not an atom-identical numerical parity experiment.
historical_spec: metadata/benchmark_spec.json is the exact reused timing configuration from the older harness. Its historical version labels do not identify this rerun; use rerun_spec.json and each raw engine_commit.
